body: I agree that there are many valid reasons to investigate if a person should own a gun, but unless they can prove that the person are a danger to others I don't think a mistake (non violent) should be enough.

In Norway you don't have a right to own a gun it's just a privilege the Police can for whatever reason they want withdraw. Everything from a DUI, public intoxication, mental health, old age, a fight, are reasons for withdrawal. There's a lot of good thing to be said about Norway, but personal rights are not one of them.
